newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris bourse closes 0.45 percent higher.
newsitem.headline: Paris bourse closes 0.45 percent higher.

text.p: French shares closed 0.45 percent higher after a weaker start as a stronger Wall Street cancelled out the effect of an easier dollar, brokers said.
Volume was boosted by the start of a buy-out bid by Cie Bancaire on its Cardif and UFB-Locabail ubts which jumped to their bid prices.
Total volume was 6.3 billion francs, of which 3.4 billion in CAC-40 shares and one billion in Cardif alone. The CAC-40 index closed up 13.18, or 0.45 percent, at 2,947.66.
CAC-40 July futures ended at 2,951 against 2,938 at Friday's close.
The broader SBF120 index up 9.06 at 2,010.99
Eramet closed 7.12 percent higher at 286 francs ahead of a key board meeting on July 9 on its mining assets on new Caledonia.

Eurotunnel closed 5.13 percent higher at 8.20 and continued its recentrise on debt deal approval hopes and licence extension. Executive chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Sunday that a judicial inquiry had shown thatEurotunnel was not responsible for the fire in November which caused big damage.
Bertrand Faure among the biggest fallers, down 2.48 percent at321.80 francs.
